messages:
maya: Starting mid-roll for `route_v3`: 25% -> 60% -> 100% (5m / 10m / final). Pin runtime image v3.2.1. Deploy-bot kick off at window.
ben: ack. I'll watch p95 + 5xx. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.5% for 3m OR p95 +150ms for 5m -> snapback to 0%.
priya: on logs/traces. Enabling `debug-microcanary` 0.1% with forced trace sampling.
deploy-bot: job db-6778901234 created. Targets: api-gateway, inference-router. Started -> 25% at 6778901238.
sre-oncall: adding alert `route_v3_error_rate_high` (5xx > 0.4% for 4m).
ben: +6m p95 +30ms, 5xx 0.1% 94 within tolerances.
priya: small auth-timeout spike from cohort 27. Recommend venting that cohort to 12% and increase sampling.
maya: vent cohort 27 to 12% now; avoids full rollback.
deploy-bot: cohort 27 vented to 12%.
sre-oncall: alert fired briefly, auto-cleared after vent.
ben: proceeding to 60% after stabilization window.
deploy-bot: advanced -> 60% at 6778901220 (rolling eu-west).
priya: eu-west p95 +180ms sustained 4m, 5xx 0.46% 94 borderline.
maya: HOLD. If 5xx > 0.5% for 1m, run emergency snapback: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/flags/route_v3 -d '{"percentage":0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN"` and `deploy-bot drain db-6778901234`.
priya: traces point to router kernel mismatch on subset of instances. Infra cordon in flight.
sre-oncall: cordon completed; traffic rerouted. Metrics improving.
ben: eu-west p95 back near baseline, 5xx down to 0.12%. Safe to continue after 4m stable.
maya: proceed to 100%. deploy-bot finish rollout and mark job complete.
deploy-bot: job db-6778901234 -> 100% at 6778901248. Rollout complete.
maya: post-deploy: 1) remove microcanary, 2) disable forced sampling, 3) restore alert sensitivity, 4) include vented cohorts + infra remediation in release notes. Ben/priya please follow up.
